## Overview

Document the B200 vLLM AgentX lane from [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#3837](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3837) (head `d2d90439`, [run 38438383633](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/38438383633)) in `recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml`, in both the guide and the command builder. Supersedes vllm-project/recipes#1106 (recipes moved here in #61302).

## Claims

- **Guide** (under **AgentX tuning on NVIDIA GPUs**): all 17 qualified points. TP4 c1–c128 (per-point `--max-num-seqs`, batched tokens 4096/8192, capture 4092/8190, decode-replay graphs from c16); TP2 c1; DEP2 c8–c32 (`--max-num-seqs` per DP rank 16/32, capture 576 at c8/c16, 4096 graphs and `--prefill-schedule-interval 64` at c24/c32); DEP4 c64–c128 (8192 batched tokens, capture 8190, interval 48 at c96/c128); DEP2 host KV at c64/c128 (32 GiB native offload per DP rank, 0.955, `--max-num-seqs 48` per rank, interval 1, capture 576).
- **Command builder** (B200 only): Tensor Parallel renders the TP2 c1 settings (FlashInfer autotune, 0.97, V2 runner, THP Engram). Data + Expert Parallel renders the DEP2 c24/c32 engine settings (FlashInfer sparse MLA, autotune + MegaMoE, Engram in host memory with embedding across DP, 0.97, V2 runner).
- The guide's builder pointer names the 0909 checkpoint the lane used, the opt-in Speculative decoding and Text only toggles, and the DP size to pin (with the router's `--intra-node-data-parallel-size`).
- The **Blackwell TP and DEP** section notes the B200 exception.

## Validation

- Builder renders compared against the run's launch lines: Tensor Parallel matches TP2 c1 flag for flag; Data + Expert Parallel matches DEP2 c24 except `--data-parallel-size` (the builder's single-node DEP spans the node; the guide says to pin 2 or 4).
- Rendered every hardware x strategy x feature selection: only B200 Tensor Parallel and Data + Expert Parallel change (16 of 1848 renders).
- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` passes; merges cleanly with the B300 follow-up to #62561.

## Details

Per-concurrency values stay in the guide because the builder renders one preset per strategy. The speculative-decoding feature keeps the shared NVIDIA default (no B200-specific override). Excluded as InferenceX harness only: synthetic acceptance, AIPerf/trace replay, Slurm and telemetry.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

@@ -316,10 +316,16 @@ strategy_overrides:
       # pinned host DRAM keeps that resident footprint inside HBM on these
       # SKUs; the lookups read the tables through UVA and the output is
       # unchanged.
-      # B200 TP2 serves the low-concurrency (c1) agentic setting: THP-backed
-      # Engram tables, 4096 batched tokens, and graphs captured up to 4092 tokens.
+      # B200 TP2 serves the low-concurrency (c1) agentic setting
+      # (SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#3837): THP-backed Engram tables, FlashInfer
+      # autotuning, 0.97 GPU memory, the V2 model runner, 4096 batched tokens,
+      # and graphs captured up to 4092 tokens.
       b200:
         extra_args:
+          - "--kernel-config"
+          - '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":true}'
+          - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+          - "0.97"
           - "--engram-config"
           - '{"cpu_offload":true,"use_thp":true}'
           - "--max-num-seqs"
@@ -330,6 +336,8 @@ strategy_overrides:
           - '{"mode":"VLLM_COMPILE","cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2046,3072,4092]}'
           - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
           - "4092"
+        extra_env:
+          VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
       gb200:
         extra_args:
           - "--engram-config"
@@ -382,11 +390,22 @@ strategy_overrides:
           - "128"
           - "--engram-config"
           - '{"embedding_across_dp":true}'
-      # B200 DEP2 at c32: piecewise graphs extend to 4096 tokens so prefill-bearing
-      # steps replay graphs, and new prefills are admitted every 64 engine steps,
-      # aligned across DP ranks. The vLLM default of 1 admits on every step.
+      # B200 DEP2 at c24/c32 (SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#3837): FlashInfer sparse MLA,
+      # Engram tables in host memory, piecewise graphs to 4096 tokens so
+      # prefill-bearing steps replay graphs, and new prefills admitted every 64
+      # engine steps, aligned across DP ranks (the vLLM default of 1 admits on every
+      # step). The builder's DEP spans all 8 GPUs; the qualified lane runs DEP2
+      # (`--data-parallel-size 2`) and DEP4; see "AgentX tuning on NVIDIA GPUs" in the guide.
       b200:
         extra_args:
+          - "--attention-config"
+          - '{"backend":"FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41","indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}'
+          - "--kernel-config"
+          - '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":true,"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}'
+          - "--engram-config"
+          - '{"cpu_offload":true,"embedding_across_dp":true}'
+          - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+          - "0.97"
           - "--max-num-seqs"
           - "32"
           - "--max-num-batched-tokens"

           - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
           - "4096"
+        extra_env:
+          VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
   pd_cluster:
     # Verified 1P1D on GB200 NVL4: one tray per role, TP4 each, NIXL transfer.
     # GB300: DEP4 prefill + DEP16 decode (SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#3941).
@@ -888,23 +909,69 @@ guide: |
   configuration (`--max-cudagraph-capture-size 8190`),
   `--max-num-batched-tokens 8192` and `--max-num-seqs 256`; B200, GB200 and
   GB300 add Engram CPU offload and otherwise inherit the shared Blackwell
-  settings. Scheduler limits are workload-dependent at TP2, so size
+  settings. B200 is the exception for both strategies: it renders the qualified B200
+  AgentX settings described in **AgentX tuning on NVIDIA GPUs**, so B200 DEP uses
+  `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41`, `{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":true,"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}`,
+  `{"cpu_offload":true,"embedding_across_dp":true}` and `--max-num-seqs 32`.
+  Scheduler limits are workload-dependent at TP2, so size
   `--max-num-batched-tokens` and `--max-cudagraph-capture-size` for your own
   serving profile. For high interactivity on any of them, use
   `--tensor-parallel-size 4`.
 
   ## AgentX tuning on NVIDIA GPUs
 
-  On B200, TP2 at concurrency 1 uses `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"use_thp":true}'`,
-  `--max-num-seqs 8` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`. DEP2 (TP1 x DP2 with expert
-  parallelism) serves concurrency 8 to 32; at c8 and c16 graph capture stops at 576 tokens and
-  `--prefill-schedule-interval` stays at the vLLM default of 1, while c32 extends piecewise
-  graphs to 4096 tokens and sets `--prefill-schedule-interval 64`. DEP4 sets
-  `--prefill-schedule-interval 48` at c128 and keeps the default of 1 at c64.
+  The B200 AgentX lane ([SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#3837](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3837))
+  serves the 0909 launch checkpoint ([deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash);
+  pick **FP8 (0909)** to match it) with FlashInfer autotuning
+  (`--kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":true}'`), `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.97`
+  and `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` on every point.
+
+  **TP4** serves concurrency 1 to 128 with `--tensor-parallel-size 4`, THP-backed Engram tables
+  (`--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"use_thp":true}'`) and these per-point limits:
+
+  | Concurrency | `--max-num-seqs` | `--max-num-batched-tokens` | `--max-cudagraph-capture-size` |
+  |---|---|---|---|
+  | 1, 4 | 8 | 4096 | 4092 |
+  | 8, 16 | 16, 32 | 8192 | 8190 |
+  | 32, 64, 128 | 64, 128, 256 | 8192 | 8190 |
+
+  Every TP4 point captures piecewise graphs at the DSpark verification multiples
+  `[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2046,3072,4092]`,
+  extended with `6144,8190` from c8. From c16 it also captures decode-replay graphs separately,
+  with the same `decoder_replay_cudagraph_capture_sizes` as DEP4 below.
+
+  **TP2** at concurrency 1 runs the TP4 c1 settings on two GPUs (`--max-num-seqs 8`,
+  `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`, capture to 4092).
+
+  **DEP2** (TP1 x DP2 with expert parallelism) serves concurrency 8 to 32 with
+  `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`. `--max-num-seqs` is per DP rank: 16 at c8 and c16 and 32 at
+  c24 and c32. At c8 and c16 graph capture stops at 576 tokens
+  (`--max-cudagraph-capture-size 576`) and `--prefill-schedule-interval` stays at the vLLM
+  default of 1, while c24 and c32 extend piecewise graphs to 4096 tokens and set
+  `--prefill-schedule-interval 64`.
+
+  **DEP4** (TP1 x DP4) serves concurrency 64 to 128 with `--max-num-batched-tokens 8192` and
+  `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 8190`. `--max-num-seqs` is 64 at c64, 96 at c96 and 128 at
+  c128. It sets `--prefill-schedule-interval 48` at c96 and c128 and keeps the default of 1
+  at c64. Decode-replay graphs are captured separately:
+
+  ```
+  --compilation-config '{"mode":"VLLM_COMPILE","cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2046,3072,4092,6144,8190],"decoder_replay_cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2048,2304,2560,2816,3072,3328,3584,3840,4096]}'
+  ```
 
-  For DEP2 at c128, add vLLM's native CPU KV offloading with
+  **DEP2 with host KV** at c64 and c128 adds vLLM's native CPU KV offloading with
   `--kv-offloading-backend native --kv-offloading-size 32` (GiB per DP rank, 64 GiB per
-  server), `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.955` and `--max-num-seqs 48`.
+  server), `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.955` and `--max-num-seqs 48`. `--max-num-seqs` is per
+  DP rank, so the server runs up to 96 sequences: nothing queues at c64, and about 32 clients
+  wait at c128. It keeps `--prefill-schedule-interval` at 1 and captures graphs only up to
+  576 tokens (`--max-cudagraph-capture-size 576`), as DEP2 does at c8 and c16.
+
+  In the command builder, pick **B200** and the **FP8 (0909)** checkpoint, and tick
+  **Speculative decoding** and **Text only** (both are opt-in). **Tensor Parallel** then
+  renders the TP2 c1 settings, and **Data + Expert Parallel** renders the DEP2 c24/c32 engine
+  settings. The builder's DEP spans all eight GPUs, so set `--data-parallel-size 2` (or 4 for
+  DEP4), select the matching GPUs, change the vLLM Router's `--intra-node-data-parallel-size`
+  to the same value, and take the per-concurrency values above.
 
   ### Aggregate serving on B300
